card.fires_on: The last piece of a newly split, uncommon brand drug name written in capitals, such as RETEVMO, ERLEADA or QFITLIA, when the name is mentioned in label text.

modes.label: Capitalized brand name ending
modes.description: Closing piece of an all-caps brand name used as the subject of a warning or instruction.
modes.example: Grades 1-3 Withhold RETEV<<MO>> until resolution of the event.
